description: This file defines a utility module for object detection, including a Bounding Box class, functions for calculating IOU, overlapping intervals, and drawing bounding boxes on images.

classes.name: BoundBox
classes.description: Represents a bounding box with coordinates, class probabilities, and methods to retrieve label and score.

methods.name: get_label
methods.description: Returns the label index with the highest class probability.

methods.name: get_score
methods.description: Returns the confidence score for the predicted label.

methods.name: _interval_overlap
methods.description: Calculates the overlap length between two intervals.

methods.name: bbox_iou
methods.description: Calculates the Intersection over Union (IoU) between two bounding boxes.

methods.name: draw_boxes
methods.description: Draws bounding boxes and labels on an image for a list of detected boxes.
